name: West University of Timisoara
overview:
The University of West Timişoara (WUT) is the main higher education and research center in western Romania.

Its community has about 16,000 students and over 700 teachers. It is a university with character, and has a total of 11 faculties.

It offers students the possibility of combining theoretical and practical knowledge in a multidisciplinary and interdisciplinary environment, by preparing them to enter a globalized job market.

Almost 5% of its student population is international.

WUT is part of a very multicultural and dynamic city offering many options for work and leisure.

Timişoara is not only a cosmopolitan city very connected to the rest of Europe, but also one of the cities with the best broadband in the world.

The university also benefits from a modern and fully equipped library, as well as several cultural centers.

administrative:
1) Application dossier

Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application. All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline (see EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline).

If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet, please be patient.

To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract.
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier.


2) Visa

  • For European students, a valid passport/ national ID card is sufficient to travel to Europe (exception for the UK).
  • For non-Europeans students or students with a non-European citizenship, please check the immigration office of the host country to check the visa process and fees.
  • Students in France can use this website: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance

For European students

The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM in French) is nominative and individual. This card certifies your rights to the Health Insurance in Europe. To obtain your card, log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure. It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks. You can also download it online.

For more information: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger

For non-European students

You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay. Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more information depending on the wanted coverage.



Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to be aware of any news (terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake…) in your host country for French citizens only:

https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/ public / login.html
accomodation:
On campus

You can apply for accommodation in a university residence. This request must be made online at the time of application. You can consult the following site for more information on these residences:

https://www.uvt.ro/en/educatie/studenti/spatii-de-cazare/

The university residences offer shared accommodations for 2 people (shared bathroom) or 3 people (private bathroom).

Internet, television, sheets and blankets are included in the accommodation. The price is around 25 € per month, charges included.

The assigned accommodation and the roommates will be established at random. The accommodation will be automatically reserved when the request is made during the application.

Two weeks before their arrival, students are informed by email of the allocation of their accommodations and of the check-in procedure.


Please note: the number of rooms available is limited. Due to limited places, the university can accommodate you in their residence only for a limited period when you are looking for off campus housing.

Please note: the residences can be located on the campus itself or in town.


Off campus

It is also possible to rent an apartment in town. This option is more expensive:

The average price for a two-room apartment being € 250 per month. Of course, the average price of accommodations varies depending on the location: the closer it is to the city center, the higher the price.

Co-location with another student allows this cost to be shared.

These prices do not take into account charges such as electricity, water or heating.

If you wish to provide for your own accommodations in Timisoara, it is recommended to contact a real estate agency or to contact the owners directly via the following advertising site:

http://www.publi24.ro/anunturi/imobiliare/de- inchiriat / timis /

To find a hotel (while looking for an apartment, for example) the recommended sites are the following:

  • http://www.hostel-costel.ro/
  • http://www.freebornhostel.com/


Please note: If you rent accommodation from a private individual, you will certainly be asked to pay the first month's rent and a month's deposit in cash. You should plan this with your bank.

Beware of scams, they are present in all countries!
courses:
60 ECTS per year

30 ECTS per semester


At this university, you will have the opportunity to take courses in the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science – Department of Computer Science.

You must take Master level courses.

You need to have a good level in maths.

Classes are from:

  • Mid-September until early February (semester 1)
  • Mid-February to early July (semester 2)

You can find the academic calendar here:

https://ri.uvt.ro/academic-calendar/?Lang=en


The courses will, of course, be given in English.

Examples of Courses

Semester 1:

  • Data bases
  • Fundamentals of AI
  • Computer Vision
  • Programming
  • Machine learning

Semester 2:

  • Data mining
  • Parallel computing
  • Multi-agent systems
  • Intelligent systems
  • Network architecture and security models



Course list is for information only and may change. EPITECH cannot be held responsible for it.
cost:
On Campus Life

On campus, students have access to a multitude of restaurants, fast food, bars and cafeterias at very affordable prices.

For daily shopping, there are also many local shops and supermarkets within walking distance.

It is also possible to get to the Iulius Mall Shopping Center by taxi for a price of around RON 10 / € 2.5 each way.


Off-Campus Considerations

Off-campus students must take into account the higher rental costs as well as the additional charges related to them.


Mobile Phone

For the mobile phone, it is possible to buy prepaid cards or purchase a subscription directly from the telephone companies that cover the territory.

The main companies are:

  • Vodafone
  • Oraange
  • Telekom
  • Digi Mobil


Food & Dining in Town

It is possible to eat at a wide variety of restaurants in town.

For an indication of prices, you can consult the following site:

https://www.tripadvisor.com/Restaurants-g298478-Timisoara_Timis_County_Western_Romania_Transylvania.html


Leisure

For prices related to leisure activities, you can inquire on this site:

http://www.timisoara-info.ro/
